title: 第5章 炼妖壶给我炼第6章 持刀狒狒捡尸大提升
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: “原来是只红毛铠猪。”
夜玄认出猪兽种族，他不急不慢侧身一躲，险而又险躲过冲击。
一棵成年人手臂粗细小树惨遭冲撞，碎木飞溅。
足以可见红毛铠猪的破坏力。
“哼哼…”
见夜玄如此轻易躲过撞击，红毛铠猪不满哼哼，后蹄暴躁刨地，将腐叶与泥块掀飞半空，前肢猛蹬，又如疾驰炮弹般撞来！
“上，夜狩，迎接你的第一场战斗。”
夜玄念动，招出齐腰高的斩夜螳螂。
斩夜螳螂目闪凶光，并未因体型差距而感到畏惧。
屈腿原地弹射，毫不犹豫杀向红毛铠猪！
种族天赋掠影，赐予斩夜螳螂远超同境界妖兽的速度！
短短几个呼吸，夜狩如幽灵般抵达红毛铠猪身侧，并朝着猪兽脖颈，挥斩墨色螳刃！
刀落。
斩在红毛铠猪皮上，发出金属相击爆鸣炸响。
诡异的震力突然爆发，当场震退斩夜螳螂！
红毛铠猪停住步伐，猪首一扭，暴虐猪瞳狠狠瞪向螳兽。
好胆！
区区小螳螂，竟敢对自己释放杀意！
它停止进攻夜玄，转而对斩夜螳螂展开攻击！
斩夜螳螂不甘示弱，本欲硬刚，脑内灵魂兽契中陡然响起夜玄声音，“境界比你高，别硬刚，把它往东南方向百米处引。”
“那里有一棵歪脖子扭树。”
夜狩会意，纵身飞掠。
“哼哧！”
见斩夜螳螂夺路逃窜，红毛铠猪还以为对方怕了自己，斜眉瞪眼，冲撞的愈加起劲…
“为何让斩夜螳螂逃跑？”
目睹此幕，黑姬颇为疑惑。
“看着就好。”
夜玄双眸绽放蓝光，气息平静。
斩夜螳螂速度极快，几个呼吸间，已是抵达歪脖子扭树身边。
它停住步伐，整装待发，静候冲撞而来的红毛铠猪。
三十米…
二十米…
十米…
五米…
距离之近，斩夜螳螂甚至都能清晰感受到红毛铠猪喷涌而出的鼻息。
三米…
二米…

"It turns out to be a red-haired armored pig."
Ye Xuan recognized the pig beast race. He ducked sideways without haste, narrowly escaping the impact.
"Bang!"
A small tree as thick as an adult's arm was struck violently, splinters flying into the air.
It is enough to show the destructive power of the red-haired armored pig.
"Hmph..."
Seeing Ye Xuan evading the impact so easily, the red-haired armored pig grunted in dissatisfaction. It scratched the ground with its hind hooves violently, flying rotten leaves and mud into the air. It kicked off with its forelimbs and hit him like a speeding cannonball!
"Come on, Ye Shou, for your first battle."
Ye Xuan thought and summoned the waist-high Night-Zhanying Mantis.
"Hiss!"
The Night-Zhanying Mantis' eyes flashed fiercely, but he was not frightened by the difference in size.
He bent his legs and ejected on the spot, killing the red-haired armored pig without hesitation!
A glimpse of the racial talent, giving the Night-Zhanying Mantis a speed far exceeding that of monsters in the same realm!
In just a few breaths, Ye Shou arrived at the side of the red-haired armored pig like a ghost, and swung the ink-colored mantis blade towards the pig's neck!
The knife fell.
When it was chopped on the red-haired armored pigskin, there was an explosion of metal hitting each other.
"Dang——!"
A strange earthquake suddenly erupted, knocking back the Night-Slaying Mantis on the spot!
? ? ?
The red-haired armored pig stopped, twisted its head, and glared at the mantis with its violent eyes.
So brave!
How dare a mere little mantis unleash his murderous intent on me!
It stopped attacking Ye Xuan and started attacking Ye Zhanye Mantis instead!
Not to be outdone, Ye Zhan Mantis wanted to be tough. Ye Xuan's voice suddenly sounded from the Soul Beast Contract in his head, "The realm is higher than yours. Don't be tough. Lead it a hundred meters to the southeast."
"There's a crooked-necked tree there."
The night hunter knew what he was doing and flew across.
"Hmph!"
Seeing the Night-Zhanying Mantis fleeing, the red-haired armored pig thought that the other party was afraid of him, so he glared sideways and charged at him with even greater vigor...
"Why did you let the Night-Zhanying Mantis escape?"
Witnessing this scene, Heiji was quite confused.
"Just watch."
Ye Xuan's eyes glowed blue and his breath was calm.
“…”
The Night-Zhanying Mantis was extremely fast, and in a few breaths, it had already reached the Wailing-Neck-Twisting Tree.
It stopped and prepared itself, waiting for the red-haired armored pig to collide.
Thirty meters…
Twenty meters…
Ten meters…
Five meters…
The distance was so close that Zhanye Mantis could clearly feel the breath coming out of the red-haired armored pig.
Three meters…
Two meters…
title_en: Chapter 5: Use the Demon Refining Pot to refine it for me. Chapter 6: The knife-wielding baboon is greatly improved in picking up corpses.
